name: py_octree_mag
algorithm: Engine/spatial_grid.py octree, criterion=magnitude: split while max over 8 corners of max(f_k/f_c, f_c/f_k) - 1 exceeds the spec's tolerance, f = sum|q|/r^2; max_depth 8; then one Coulomb/Biot-Savart call per leaf as py_octree; probes answered by nearest leaf sample
author_claim: superseded by py_octree_tol; kept so the error criterion can be reported against it at the same tolerances. Its refinement at a point source is unbounded by construction, so its point count is not a property of the tolerance
